title: Fail closed on partial preset policy apply
summary: Make PresetV2 apply disclose every unsupported policy difference and block before settings mutation when the legacy adapter cannot represent the reviewed preset.
reason: Remediate P1 AUDIT-FIND-W02-008. PresetV2 validates eleven policy sections, but preset-library apply silently persists only the legacy adapter subset and reports success while unrelated prior audio, subtitle, verification, filter, guard, and publish settings remain active.
behavior_before: Preview and confirmed apply expose only the reduced legacy patch and do not disclose that most reviewed policy fields will be ignored.
behavior_after: Preview projects the legacy patch over current config, compares every unrepresented policy leaf with the resulting effective PresetV2, reports exact desired/current/post-apply differences, and confirmed apply fails closed before settings save whenever the reviewed policy would remain incomplete.
tests_added: An exhaustive adapter coverage contract ties every emitted legacy config key to an explicit PresetV2 alias path and verifies current-effective presets have no unsupported differences.
Audio force-transcode, BDPGS conversion, and source-integrity fixtures prove preview reports exact unsupported paths and confirmed apply never calls settings save.
A current-effective policy fixture proves represented changes retain the existing confirmed settings-save path.

rollback_plan: Revert the explicit adapter coverage contract, fail-closed preview/apply policy, focused tests, generated context, and packet metadata together; retain this packet as incomplete evidence if rollback occurs.
notes: High-risk media-policy configuration boundary. The comparison evaluates the effective PresetV2 produced after overlaying the explicit legacy patch, so deterministic codec/height/guard derivations are accepted only when they really match the reviewed preset. This bounded batch does not add or change audio, subtitle, verification, filter, guard, or publish mappings; it blocks silent partial application until complete mappings receive their own representative real-media validation. Representative real media is not required because no new policy becomes effective.
